description.ar: تعلّم كيف تتنقل في المدينة وتتحدث عن وسائل المواصلات.
description.en: Learn to get around a city and talk about public transport.
description.id: Belajar berkeliling kota dan membicarakan transportasi umum.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أقول كيف أذهب إلى العمل بالحافلة أو القطار.
objectives.en: I can say how I get to work by bus or train.
objectives.id: Saya bisa mengatakan bagaimana saya pergi kerja naik bus atau kereta.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أسأل عن المحطات والتذاكر.
objectives.en: I can ask about stations, stops and tickets.
objectives.id: Saya bisa bertanya tentang stasiun, halte, dan tiket.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أصف الازدحام وأماكن المدينة الشائعة.
objectives.en: I can describe traffic and common places in a city.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menggambarkan kemacetan dan tempat umum di kota.

intro.ar: في هذا الدرس ستتعلم عبارات تحتاجها كل يوم في المدينة: ركوب الحافلة، والسؤال عن المحطة، وشراء التذكرة. هذه العبارات مفيدة جدًا عند السفر أو العيش في بلد ناطق بالإنجليزية.
intro.en: In this lesson you will learn phrases you need every day in a city: taking the bus, asking about the station and buying a ticket. They are very useful when you travel or live in an English-speaking country.
intro.id: Dalam pelajaran ini Anda akan belajar ungkapan yang dibutuhkan setiap hari di kota: naik bus, bertanya soal stasiun, dan membeli tiket. Sangat berguna saat bepergian atau tinggal di negara berbahasa Inggris.

culture.ar: في المدن الإنجليزية يستخدم الناس بطاقات إلكترونية للحافلات والمترو، ومن المعتاد قول "Excuse me" عند المرور بين الناس. في بريطانيا تقول "return ticket" وفي أمريكا "round-trip ticket" لتذكرة الذهاب والعودة.
culture.en: In English-speaking cities people often pay with a card or app, and it is normal to say "Excuse me" when you pass someone. In Britain a ticket there and back is a "return", in the US it is a "round-trip".
culture.id: Di kota berbahasa Inggris orang sering membayar dengan kartu atau aplikasi, dan wajar mengatakan "Excuse me" saat melewati orang. Di Inggris tiket pulang-pergi disebut "return", di Amerika "round-trip".

title.en: Using take and by with transport
title.id: Memakai take dan by untuk transportasi

body.ar: نقول "take the bus" أو "go by bus" بنفس المعنى تقريبًا. لاحظ أننا نستخدم the مع take (take the train) ولا نستخدم أداة التعريف مع by (by train). ونسأل عن المدة بـ "How long does it take?".
body.en: We say "take the bus" or "go by bus" with almost the same meaning. Notice that take uses the (take the train) but by does not (by train). To ask about time, use "How long does it take?".
body.id: Kita bisa mengatakan "take the bus" atau "go by bus" dengan arti hampir sama. Perhatikan: take memakai the (take the train), sedangkan by tidak (by train). Untuk menanyakan lama perjalanan: "How long does it take?".

why.en: We say "take the bus" for travelling by bus. Make and wear do not fit the meaning.
why.id: Kita mengatakan "take the bus" untuk naik bus. Make dan wear tidak cocok artinya.

why.en: A traffic jam is what makes people late on the road. A post office or a ticket does not cause that.
why.id: Kemacetan membuat orang terlambat di jalan. Kantor pos atau tiket tidak menyebabkan hal itu.

why.en: The correct reply gives directions, which is what the question asks for. The other two are good sentences but do not answer how to get there.
why.id: Jawaban yang benar memberi petunjuk arah sesuai pertanyaan. Dua lainnya kalimat yang benar tetapi tidak menjawab cara menuju ke sana.

summary.ar: تعلّمت عبارات المواصلات مثل take the bus وone-way ticket وأماكن المدينة. تذكّر الفرق بين take the bus وby bus.
summary.en: You learned transport phrases like take the bus and one-way ticket, plus city places. Remember the difference between take the bus and by bus.
summary.id: Anda belajar ungkapan transportasi seperti take the bus dan one-way ticket, serta tempat di kota. Ingat perbedaan take the bus dan by bus.

description.ar: تعلّم كيف تطلب المساعدة وتصف مشكلة صحية بالإنجليزية.
description.en: Learn to ask for help and describe a health problem in English.
description.id: Belajar meminta bantuan dan menjelaskan masalah kesehatan dalam bahasa Inggris.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أقول إنني مريض وأين الألم.
objectives.en: I can say that I am sick and where it hurts.
objectives.id: Saya bisa mengatakan bahwa saya sakit dan di mana yang sakit.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أطلب طبيبًا أو مساعدة.
objectives.en: I can ask for a doctor or for help.
objectives.id: Saya bisa meminta dokter atau bantuan.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أتصرف في حالة طارئة.
objectives.en: I can act in an emergency.
objectives.id: Saya bisa bertindak dalam keadaan darurat.

intro.ar: في الحالات الصحية تحتاج إلى جمل قصيرة وواضحة. سنتعلم كيف تقول أنك مريض، وتطلب الطبيب، وتستنجد بمن حولك عند الخطر.
intro.en: When your health is at risk you need short, clear sentences. You will learn how to say you are sick, ask for a doctor and call for help in danger.
intro.id: Saat kesehatan terganggu, Anda butuh kalimat singkat dan jelas. Anda akan belajar mengatakan bahwa Anda sakit, meminta dokter, dan memanggil bantuan saat bahaya.

culture.ar: رقم الطوارئ في بريطانيا 999 وفي أمريكا 911 وفي أوروبا 112. عند الاتصال قل أولًا ما الحالة ("This is an emergency") ثم أين أنت، وتحدّث ببطء.
culture.en: The emergency number is 999 in the UK, 911 in the US and 112 in much of Europe. When you call, say what is happening first, then where you are, and speak slowly.
culture.id: Nomor darurat adalah 999 di Inggris, 911 di Amerika, dan 112 di banyak negara Eropa. Saat menelepon, sebutkan dulu apa yang terjadi, lalu lokasi Anda, dan bicara pelan-pelan.

title.id: Perintah sopan dan have untuk rasa sakit

body.ar: للشكوى من الألم نستخدم have: "I have a headache". وللطلب نضيف please إلى الأمر: "Please help me". أما "I am sick" فتعني أنك مريض بوجه عام.
body.en: To describe pain we use have: "I have a headache". For requests we add please to a command: "Please help me". "I am sick" says you are ill in general.
body.id: Untuk menyatakan sakit di bagian tubuh kita memakai have: "I have a headache". Untuk permintaan, tambahkan please pada kalimat perintah: "Please help me". "I am sick" berarti Anda sakit secara umum.

why.en: A doctor treats pain. A teacher or a driver does not treat patients.
why.id: Dokter mengobati rasa sakit. Guru atau sopir tidak mengobati pasien.

why.ar: الإسعاف مناسب للخطر. المظلة والمخرج لا يُستدعيان لإنقاذ شخص.
why.en: An ambulance fits a medical danger. You do not call an umbrella or an exit to help a person.
why.id: Ambulans cocok untuk bahaya medis. Payung atau pintu keluar tidak dipanggil untuk menolong orang.

why.en: The question asks how to help, so the right reply describes the health problem. The other two do not describe a problem.
why.id: Pertanyaannya apa yang bisa dibantu, jadi jawaban yang benar menjelaskan masalah kesehatan. Dua lainnya tidak menjelaskan masalah.

summary.id: Anda belajar mengatakan I am sick dan I have a headache, serta meminta dokter atau ambulans. Gunakan please agar sopan dan jelas.

description.ar: تحدّث عن وظيفتك وزملائك وجدول عملك.
description.en: Talk about your job, your colleagues and your work schedule.
description.id: Bicara tentang pekerjaan, rekan kerja, dan jadwal kerja Anda.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أقول ماذا أعمل وأين.
objectives.en: I can say what I do and where I work.
objectives.id: Saya bisa mengatakan apa pekerjaan saya dan di mana saya bekerja.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أصف مسؤولياتي وجدولي.
objectives.en: I can describe my duties and schedule.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menjelaskan tugas dan jadwal saya.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أبدأ حديثًا مهنيًا بسيطًا.
objectives.en: I can start a simple conversation about work.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memulai percakapan sederhana tentang pekerjaan.

intro.ar: السؤال "What do you do?" من أكثر الأسئلة شيوعًا عند التعرف على أحد. ستتعلم هنا كيف تجيب بثقة وتصف عملك وزملاءك.
intro.en: "What do you do?" is one of the most common questions when you meet someone. Here you will learn to answer with confidence and describe your work and colleagues.
intro.id: "What do you do?" adalah salah satu pertanyaan paling umum saat berkenalan. Di sini Anda belajar menjawab dengan percaya diri dan menjelaskan pekerjaan serta rekan kerja Anda.

culture.ar: في الثقافة الإنجليزية يسأل الناس عن العمل في بداية التعارف، وهو ليس سؤالًا شخصيًا مزعجًا. يحب الناس الإجابات القصيرة مثل "I'm a nurse" ثم يضيفون تفصيلًا واحدًا.
culture.en: In English-speaking cultures people often ask about work early on, and it is not rude. Short answers like "I'm a nurse" followed by one detail are normal.
culture.id: Dalam budaya berbahasa Inggris, bertanya soal pekerjaan di awal perkenalan itu wajar dan tidak kasar. Jawaban singkat seperti "I'm a nurse" lalu satu detail tambahan sudah cukup.

title.ar: work as وwork for وwork at

body.ar: نستخدم "work as" للمهنة (work as a nurse)، و"work for" للشركة (work for Google)، و"work at" للمكان (work at a bank). نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن العمل المعتاد.
body.en: Use "work as" for the job (work as a nurse), "work for" for the company (work for Google) and "work at" for the place (work at a bank). Use the present simple for regular work.
body.id: Gunakan "work as" untuk profesi (work as a nurse), "work for" untuk perusahaan (work for Google), dan "work at" untuk tempat (work at a bank). Pakai present simple untuk pekerjaan rutin.

why.en: "Works as" introduces the job. At and of do not show the job role.
why.id: "Works as" dipakai sebelum nama profesi. At dan of tidak menyatakan profesi.

why.en: The fixed phrase is "day off". "Day out" means a trip and "day away" is not used this way.
why.id: Ungkapan tetapnya "day off". "Day out" berarti jalan-jalan dan "day away" tidak dipakai begitu.

why.ar: السؤال عن المهنة، والجواب الصحيح يذكر المهنة ومكان العمل. الجوابان الآخران جمل صحيحة لكنها لا تجيب عن السؤال.
why.en: The question asks about your job, so the right reply gives job and workplace. The other replies are correct sentences but do not answer it.
why.id: Pertanyaannya tentang pekerjaan, jadi jawaban benar menyebut profesi dan tempat kerja. Dua lainnya kalimat benar tetapi tidak menjawab.

summary.ar: تعلّمت أن تقول I work as وتصف زملاءك وجدولك. تذكّر as للمهنة وfor للشركة.
summary.en: You learned to say I work as and to describe colleagues and schedule. Remember as for the job and for for the company.
summary.id: Anda belajar mengatakan I work as dan menjelaskan rekan kerja serta jadwal. Ingat as untuk profesi dan for untuk perusahaan.

description.ar: تحدّث عمّا حدث أمس أو في العطلة باستخدام الماضي البسيط.
description.en: Talk about yesterday and last weekend using the past simple.
description.id: Bicara tentang kemarin dan akhir pekan lalu memakai past simple.

objectives.ar: أستطيع استخدام الأفعال المنتظمة مثل visited وworked.
objectives.en: I can use regular verbs like visited and worked.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memakai kata kerja beraturan seperti visited dan worked.

objectives.ar: أستطيع استخدام أفعال شاذة شائعة مثل went وbought وate.
objectives.en: I can use common irregular verbs like went, bought and ate.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memakai kata kerja tak beraturan seperti went, bought, dan ate.

objectives.ar: أستطيع تكوين النفي والسؤال بـ didn't وDid.
objectives.en: I can make negatives and questions with didn't and Did.
objectives.id: Saya bisa membuat kalimat negatif dan tanya dengan didn't dan Did.

intro.ar: نستخدم الماضي البسيط للأحداث المنتهية في وقت محدد مثل yesterday وlast week. هو أول زمن ماضٍ يحتاجه كل متعلم.
intro.en: We use the past simple for finished events at a definite time, like yesterday or last week. It is the first past tense every learner needs.
intro.id: Past simple dipakai untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai pada waktu tertentu, seperti yesterday atau last week. Ini bentuk lampau pertama yang dibutuhkan setiap pelajar.

culture.ar: عندما يسألك زملاؤك "How was your weekend?" يتوقعون جوابًا بالماضي: "We went to the beach". إتقان الماضي يجعل حديثك اليومي طبيعيًا.
culture.en: When colleagues ask "How was your weekend?" they expect a past answer: "We went to the beach". Mastering the past makes your daily small talk natural.
culture.id: Saat rekan bertanya "How was your weekend?", mereka mengharapkan jawaban lampau: "We went to the beach". Menguasai bentuk lampau membuat obrolan sehari-hari terdengar alami.

title.id: Past simple: beraturan dan tak beraturan

body.ar: الأفعال المنتظمة تأخذ -ed (visit - visited). والشاذة تتغير: go - went, buy - bought, eat - ate, see - saw. في النفي والسؤال نستخدم didn't / Did مع الفعل الأصلي: "I didn't go", "Did you see it?". ونستخدم ago مثل two days ago.
body.en: Regular verbs add -ed (visit - visited). Irregular verbs change: go - went, buy - bought, eat - ate, see - saw. In negatives and questions use didn't / Did with the base verb: "I didn't go", "Did you see it?". Use ago, as in two days ago.
body.id: Kata kerja beraturan ditambah -ed (visit - visited). Yang tak beraturan berubah: go - went, buy - bought, eat - ate, see - saw. Untuk negatif dan tanya pakai didn't / Did dengan kata kerja dasar: "I didn't go", "Did you see it?". Gunakan ago, misalnya two days ago.

tr.en: I went to see a person or place

example.target: I visited my aunt last weekend.
example.translit: eye VIZ-i-tid my ANT LAST WEEK-end

tr.ar: زرت عمتي في نهاية الأسبوع الماضي.
tr.en: I visited my aunt last weekend.
tr.id: Saya mengunjungi bibi saya akhir pekan lalu.

hint.en: After t or d, -ed sounds like "id".

tr.en: past of "go": we travelled to

example.target: We went to the beach on Friday.
example.translit: wee WENT too thuh BEECH on FRY-day

tr.en: We went to the beach on Friday.
tr.id: Kami pergi ke pantai hari Jumat.

hint.en: "Went" is the irregular past of go.
hint.id: "Went" adalah bentuk lampau tak beraturan dari go.

tr.en: past of "buy": she paid for something

example.target: She bought a new phone yesterday.
example.translit: shee BAWT uh NOO FOHN YES-ter-day

tr.en: She bought a new phone yesterday.
I did not go

example.target: I didn't go to work because I was sick.
example.translit: eye DID-unt GOH too WURK bi-KUZ eye wuz SIK

tr.ar: لم أذهب إلى العمل لأنني كنت مريضًا.
tr.en: I didn't go to work because I was sick.
tr.id: Saya tidak masuk kerja karena sakit.

hint.ar: بعد didn't نستخدم الفعل الأصلي: go وليس went.
hint.en: After didn't use the base verb: go, not went.
hint.id: Setelah didn't pakai kata kerja dasar: go, bukan went.

tr.en: a question about whether you saw something

example.target: Did you see the match last night?
example.translit: did yoo SEE thuh MACH LAST NYT

tr.en: Did you see the match last night?
tr.id: Apakah kamu menonton pertandingan tadi malam?

tr.en: past of "eat": he had food

example.target: He ate rice for lunch two hours ago.
example.translit: hee ET RYS fer LUNCH too OW-erz uh-GOH

tr.ar: أكل الأرز على الغداء قبل ساعتين.
tr.en: He ate rice for lunch two hours ago.
tr.id: Dia makan nasi untuk makan siang dua jam yang lalu.

hint.ar: ate تنطق مثل et في الإنجليزية البريطانية وeit في الأمريكية.
hint.en: "Ate" sounds like "et" in British English and "ate" in some US speech.
hint.id: "Ate" dibaca "et" di Inggris dan sering "eit" di Amerika.

cloze.sentence: Yesterday I ___ to the market.

tr.en: Yesterday I went to the market.

why.ar: yesterday تتطلب الماضي، وماضي go هو went. go وgoing ليسا ماضيًا.
why.en: Yesterday needs the past, and the past of go is went. Go and going are not past forms.
why.id: Yesterday membutuhkan bentuk lampau, dan lampau go adalah went. Go dan going bukan bentuk lampau.

cloze.sentence: She ___ come to class on Monday because she was ill.

tr.ar: لم تأتِ إلى الصف يوم الاثنين لأنها كانت مريضة.
tr.en: She didn't come to class on Monday because she was ill.
tr.id: Dia tidak datang ke kelas hari Senin karena sakit.

why.ar: الجملة في الماضي، لذا didn't مع الفعل الأصلي come. doesn't للمضارع وisn't لا تُستخدم مع come.
why.en: The sentence is in the past, so didn't + base verb come. Doesn't is present and isn't does not work with come.
why.id: Kalimat ini lampau, jadi didn't + kata kerja dasar come. Doesn't untuk sekarang dan isn't tidak cocok dengan come.

context.en: Two coworkers chat on Monday morning.
context.id: Dua rekan kerja mengobrol pada Senin pagi.

turns.target: Hi Sara! How was your weekend?

tr.en: Hi Sara! How was your weekend?

turns.target: It was great! We went to the beach.

tr.en: It was great! We went to the beach.
tr.id: Seru sekali! Kami pergi ke pantai.

turns.target: Nice! Did you swim?

tr.en: Nice! Did you swim?

turns.target: Yes, we did, and we ate fish for lunch.

tr.en: Yes, we did, and we ate fish for lunch.
tr.id: Ya, dan kami makan ikan untuk makan siang.

wrong: It is great. I go to the beach every day.

why.ar: السؤال عن عطلة انتهت، فالجواب بالماضي. الجواب الثاني من المضارع، والثالث يجيب عن "How are you?".
why.en: The question is about a weekend that is over, so the answer is past. The second option is present and the third answers "How are you?".
why.id: Pertanyaan tentang akhir pekan yang sudah lewat, jadi jawabannya lampau. Pilihan kedua bentuk sekarang dan ketiga menjawab "How are you?".

summary.ar: تعلّمت الماضي البسيط للأفعال المنتظمة والشاذة مثل went وbought وate. استخدم didn't وDid مع الفعل الأصلي.
summary.en: You learned the past simple with regular and irregular verbs like went, bought and ate. Use didn't and Did with the base verb.
summary.id: Anda belajar past simple dengan kata kerja beraturan dan tak beraturan seperti went, bought, dan ate. Pakai didn't dan Did dengan kata kerja dasar.

title.id: Rencana masa depan: going to / will

description.ar: تحدّث عن خططك وتوقعاتك ووعودك المستقبلية.
description.en: Talk about your plans, predictions and promises for the future.
description.id: Bicara tentang rencana, prediksi, dan janji untuk masa depan.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أقول خططي باستخدام going to.
objectives.en: I can say my plans with going to.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menyatakan rencana dengan going to.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أعرض مساعدة أو أعد بشيء باستخدام will.
objectives.en: I can offer help or make a promise with will.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menawarkan bantuan atau berjanji dengan will.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أتنبأ بما سيحدث.
objectives.en: I can predict what will happen.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memprediksi apa yang akan terjadi.

intro.ar: هناك طريقتان شائعتان للحديث عن المستقبل: going to للخطط والتوقعات المبنية على دليل، وwill للقرارات اللحظية والوعود. سنتدرب على الاثنتين.
intro.en: There are two common ways to talk about the future: going to for plans and predictions with evidence, and will for quick decisions and promises. We will practise both.
intro.id: Ada dua cara umum membicarakan masa depan: going to untuk rencana dan prediksi berdasar bukti, will untuk keputusan spontan dan janji. Kita akan melatih keduanya.

culture.ar: في الحياة اليومية يقول الناس "I'm going to..." عند الحديث عن عطلة أو عمل، و"I'll..." عندما يعرضون المساعدة فجأة. استخدام الصيغة الصحيحة يجعل كلامك أقرب إلى كلام أهل اللغة.
culture.en: In daily life people say "I'm going to..." about holidays or work, and "I'll..." when they suddenly offer help. Choosing the right form makes you sound more natural.
culture.id: Dalam kehidupan sehari-hari orang berkata "I'm going to..." tentang liburan atau pekerjaan, dan "I'll..." saat tiba-tiba menawarkan bantuan. Memilih bentuk yang tepat membuat bicara Anda lebih alami.

body.ar: نستخدم am/is/are going to + فعل للخطط المقررة وللتوقع عندما نرى دليلًا ("Look at the clouds. It's going to rain"). ونستخدم will + فعل للقرارات الفورية وللوعد والرأي ("I'll help you", "I think she will like it"). النفي: won't.
body.en: Use am/is/are going to + verb for decided plans and for predictions when you see evidence ("Look at the clouds. It's going to rain"). Use will + verb for quick decisions, promises and opinions ("I'll help you", "I think she will like it"). Negative: won't.
body.id: Pakai am/is/are going to + kata kerja untuk rencana yang sudah diputuskan dan prediksi berdasar bukti ("Look at the clouds. It's going to rain"). Pakai will + kata kerja untuk keputusan spontan, janji, dan pendapat ("I'll help you", "I think she will like it"). Negatif: won't.

tr.en: a way to say what you have decided to do

example.target: I'm going to study tonight.
example.translit: eye-m GOH-ing too STUD-ee tuh-NYT

tr.en: I'm going to study tonight.
a quick offer to give help

example.target: That bag looks heavy. I'll help you.
example.translit: THAT BAG LUKS HEV-ee eye-l HELP yoo

tr.en: That bag looks heavy. I'll help you.
tr.id: Tas itu kelihatan berat. Saya bantu.

tr.en: rain is about to come, and I can see signs

example.target: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
example.translit: LUK at THOHZ KLOWDZ its GOH-ing too RAYN

tr.en: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
an opinion about the future

example.target: I think she will like the gift.
example.translit: eye THINGK shee WIL LYK thuh GIFT

tr.en: I think she will like the gift.
tr.id: Saya kira dia akan suka hadiahnya.

tr.en: a question about someone's plan

example.target: Are you going to come to the party?
example.translit: ar yoo GOH-ing too KUM too thuh PAR-tee

tr.en: Are you going to come to the party?
tr.id: Apakah kamu akan datang ke pesta?

tr.en: a promise that you will arrive on time

example.target: Don't worry, I won't be late.
example.translit: DOHNT WUR-ee eye WOHNT bee LAYT

tr.en: Don't worry, I won't be late.
tr.id: Jangan khawatir, saya tidak akan terlambat.

cloze.sentence: We have bought the tickets. We ___ fly to Jakarta next week.

tr.ar: اشترينا التذاكر. سنسافر إلى جاكرتا الأسبوع القادم.
tr.en: We have bought the tickets. We are going to fly to Jakarta next week.
tr.id: Kami sudah membeli tiket. Kami akan terbang ke Jakarta minggu depan.

why.ar: خطة مقررة مع we تتطلب are going to. is لا تناسب we، وwill to خطأ نحوي.
why.en: A decided plan with we needs are going to. Is does not agree with we and "will to" is incorrect.
why.id: Rencana yang sudah diputuskan dengan we memakai are going to. Is tidak cocok dengan we dan "will to" salah.

cloze.sentence: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.

tr.en: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

why.ar: قرار لحظي يتطلب will. "going to" بدون am غير صحيحة، وdid للماضي.
why.en: A sudden decision needs will. "Going to" without am is wrong and did is past.
why.id: Keputusan spontan memakai will. "Going to" tanpa am salah dan did untuk lampau.

context.ar: صديقان يتحدثان عن عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
context.en: Two friends talk about the weekend.
context.id: Dua teman mengobrol tentang akhir pekan.

turns.target: What are you going to do this weekend?

tr.ar: ماذا ستفعل في نهاية هذا الأسبوع؟
tr.en: What are you going to do this weekend?
tr.id: Kamu akan melakukan apa akhir pekan ini?

turns.target: I'm going to visit my parents. What about you?

tr.en: I'm going to visit my parents. What about you?
tr.id: Saya akan mengunjungi orang tua. Kalau kamu?

turns.target: I don't have any plans yet.

tr.en: I don't have any plans yet.

turns.target: Maybe you will come with us!

tr.en: Maybe you will come with us!

why.ar: السؤال عن خطة مستقبلية، فالجواب الصحيح يستخدم I'm going to. الجواب الأول ماضٍ والثاني لا يجيب عن السؤال.
why.en: The question is about a future plan, so the right reply uses I'm going to. The first option is past and the second does not answer.
why.id: Pertanyaannya tentang rencana, jadi jawaban benar memakai I'm going to. Pilihan pertama lampau dan kedua tidak menjawab.

summary.ar: تعلّمت أن going to للخطط والتوقعات بدليل، وwill للقرارات اللحظية والوعود. النفي مع will هو won't.
summary.en: You learned that going to is for plans and predictions with evidence, and will for quick decisions and promises. The negative of will is won't.
summary.id: Anda belajar bahwa going to untuk rencana dan prediksi berdasar bukti, dan will untuk keputusan spontan dan janji. Negatif will adalah won't.

title.en: Modal verbs: can, could, should, must, would like
title.id: Kata kerja modal: can, could, should, must, would like

description.ar: استخدم الأفعال الناقصة لتطلب وتنصح وتعبّر عن الواجب.
description.en: Use modal verbs to ask, advise and talk about obligation.
description.id: Gunakan kata kerja modal untuk meminta, menyarankan, dan menyatakan kewajiban.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أطلب شيئًا بأدب بـ Can وCould.
objectives.en: I can make polite requests with Can and Could.
objectives.id: Saya bisa meminta dengan sopan memakai Can dan Could.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أقدم نصيحة بـ should وأقول الواجب بـ must.
objectives.en: I can give advice with should and say rules with must.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memberi saran dengan should dan menyatakan aturan dengan must.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أطلب بـ I'd like وأفرّق بين must وdon't have to.
objectives.en: I can order with I'd like and tell must from don't have to.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memesan dengan I'd like dan membedakan must dari don't have to.

intro.ar: الأفعال الناقصة تأتي قبل الفعل الأصلي ولا تأخذ s ولا to بعدها. ستتعلم الأكثر استعمالًا في الحياة اليومية.
intro.en: Modal verbs come before the base verb and take no -s and no "to" after them. You will learn the ones used most in daily life.
intro.id: Kata kerja modal berada sebelum kata kerja dasar, tanpa -s dan tanpa "to" sesudahnya. Anda akan belajar yang paling sering dipakai sehari-hari.

culture.ar: في المطاعم والمتاجر يفضّل الناس "Could you...?" و"I'd like..." لأنها أكثر أدبًا من الطلب المباشر. قول "I want a coffee" مباشرةً قد يبدو فظًّا.
culture.en: In restaurants and shops people prefer "Could you...?" and "I'd like...", which are more polite than direct requests. Saying "I want a coffee" can sound rude.
culture.id: Di restoran dan toko orang lebih suka "Could you...?" dan "I'd like...", karena lebih sopan daripada permintaan langsung. Mengatakan "I want a coffee" bisa terdengar kasar.

body.ar: can للقدرة والإذن، وcould للطلب المهذب، وshould للنصيحة، وmust للواجب القوي، وwould like للرغبة المهذبة. انتبه: "You must" تعني واجبًا، لكن "You don't have to" تعني أنه ليس مطلوبًا.
body.en: Can is for ability and permission, could for polite requests, should for advice, must for strong obligation, and would like for polite wishes. Careful: "You must" is an obligation, but "You don't have to" means it is not necessary.
body.id: Can untuk kemampuan dan izin, could untuk permintaan sopan, should untuk saran, must untuk kewajiban kuat, dan would like untuk keinginan sopan. Hati-hati: "You must" berarti wajib, tetapi "You don't have to" berarti tidak perlu.

tr.en: a way to ask for permission

example.target: Can I use your phone?
example.translit: KAN eye YOOZ yor FOHN

tr.en: Can I use your phone?
a polite way to ask someone to do something

example.target: Could you open the window, please?
example.translit: KUD yoo OH-pun thuh WIN-doh PLEEZ

tr.ar: هل تستطيع أن تفتح النافذة من فضلك؟
tr.en: Could you open the window, please?
a way to give advice

example.target: You should drink more water.
example.translit: yoo SHUD DRINGK MOR WAW-ter

tr.ar: عليك أن تشرب مزيدًا من الماء.
tr.en: You should drink more water.
tr.id: Sebaiknya Anda minum lebih banyak air.

tr.en: a strong rule: it is necessary

example.target: You must wear a seat belt in the car.
example.translit: yoo MUST WAIR uh SEET belt in thuh KAR

tr.ar: يجب أن تضع حزام الأمان في السيارة.
tr.en: You must wear a seat belt in the car.
tr.id: Anda harus memakai sabuk pengaman di mobil.

tr.en: a polite way to say what you want

example.target: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
example.translit: eyd LYK uh KUP uv TEE PLEEZ

tr.en: I'd like a cup of tea, please.

hint.ar: الصيغة المختصرة I'd like شائعة جدًا.
hint.en: The short form I'd like is very common.
hint.id: Bentuk singkat I'd like sangat umum.

tr.en: it is not necessary for you

example.target: You don't have to come early.
example.translit: yoo DOHNT HAV too KUM UR-lee

tr.en: You don't have to come early.

hint.ar: لا تخلط مع mustn't التي تعني ممنوع.
hint.en: Do not confuse with mustn't, which means forbidden.
hint.id: Jangan tertukar dengan mustn't yang berarti dilarang.

cloze.sentence: It is very cold. You ___ wear a warm coat.

tr.ar: الجو بارد جدًا. من الأفضل أن ترتدي معطفًا دافئًا.
tr.en: It is very cold. You should wear a warm coat.
tr.id: Udara sangat dingin. Sebaiknya Anda memakai mantel hangat.

why.ar: should تعطي نصيحة وتأتي قبل الفعل الأصلي. to وdoes لا تصحان هنا.
why.en: Should gives advice and comes before the base verb. To and does are wrong here.
why.id: Should memberi saran dan diikuti kata kerja dasar. To dan does salah di sini.

cloze.sentence: ___ you pass the salt, please?

tr.ar: هل تستطيع أن تمرر الملح من فضلك؟
tr.en: Could you pass the salt, please?

why.ar: Could you طلب مهذب. Must أمر قوي، وWould like لا تأتي بهذا الشكل مع you.
why.en: "Could you" is a polite request. Must is a strong order, and "Would like you pass" is wrong.
why.id: "Could you" adalah permintaan sopan. Must terlalu keras dan "Would like you pass" salah.

context.en: A customer orders food in a restaurant.

turns.target: Are you ready to order?

tr.en: Are you ready to order?

turns.target: Yes. I'd like the grilled chicken, please.

tr.ar: نعم. أودّ الدجاج المشوي من فضلك.
tr.en: Yes. I'd like the grilled chicken, please.

turns.target: Would you like something to drink?

tr.en: Would you like something to drink?

turns.target: Just water, please.

tr.en: Just water, please.

wrong: No, I don't have to order.

why.ar: السؤال هل أنت جاهز، والجواب الصحيح يطلب الطعام بأدب بـ I'd like. الجوابان الآخران لا يناسبان موقف الزبون.
why.en: The question asks if you are ready, so the right reply orders politely with I'd like. The others do not suit a customer.
why.id: Pertanyaannya apakah siap, jadi jawaban benar memesan dengan sopan memakai I'd like. Dua lainnya tidak cocok untuk pelanggan.

summary.ar: تعلّمت can وcould وshould وmust وwould like. تذكّر الفرق بين must وdon't have to.
summary.en: You learned can, could, should, must and would like. Remember the difference between must and don't have to.
summary.id: Anda belajar can, could, should, must, dan would like. Ingat perbedaan must dan don't have to.

description.ar: تعلّم عبارات المكالمات والرسائل والبريد الإلكتروني المهذبة.
description.en: Learn polite phrases for phone calls, emails and messages.
description.id: Pelajari ungkapan sopan untuk telepon, email, dan pesan.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أبدأ مكالمة وأطلب الانتظار أو ترك رسالة.
objectives.en: I can start a call and ask someone to hold or leave a message.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memulai telepon dan meminta menunggu atau meninggalkan pesan.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أشرح سبب الاتصال.
objectives.en: I can explain why I am calling.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menjelaskan alasan menelepon.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أكتب بريدًا مهذبًا وأنهيه بشكل صحيح.
objectives.en: I can write a polite email and end it properly.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menulis email sopan dan menutupnya dengan benar.

intro.ar: المحادثة الهاتفية والبريد لهما عباراتهما الخاصة، وهي مختلفة عن الكلام وجهًا لوجه. ستتعلم عبارات جاهزة تناسب العمل والحياة اليومية.
intro.en: Phone calls and emails have their own phrases, different from face-to-face talk. You will learn ready-made phrases for work and daily life.
intro.id: Telepon dan email punya ungkapan tersendiri yang berbeda dari percakapan tatap muka. Anda akan belajar ungkapan siap pakai untuk pekerjaan dan kehidupan sehari-hari.

culture.ar: في الهاتف تعرّف بنفسك بقول "This is Anna" وليس "I am Anna". وفي البريد الرسمي تبدأ بـ Dear وتنهي بـ Best regards، أما مع الأصدقاء فتكفي Hi وThanks.
culture.en: On the phone you introduce yourself with "This is Anna", not "I am Anna". In formal emails you start with Dear and end with Best regards; with friends Hi and Thanks are enough.
culture.id: Di telepon Anda memperkenalkan diri dengan "This is Anna", bukan "I am Anna". Di email resmi mulai dengan Dear dan akhiri dengan Best regards; dengan teman cukup Hi dan Thanks.

body.ar: للاتصال نقول "I'm calling about..." وللكتابة "I'm writing to ask about...". ونعد بالاتصال لاحقًا بـ will: "I'll call you back". في الرسائل الرسمية نتجنب الاختصارات ونستخدم may وcould للطلب.
body.en: On the phone say "I'm calling about..."; in writing say "I'm writing to ask about...". Promise a later call with will: "I'll call you back". In formal messages avoid short forms and use may and could for requests.
body.id: Di telepon katakan "I'm calling about..."; dalam tulisan "I'm writing to ask about...". Berjanji menelepon lagi dengan will: "I'll call you back". Dalam pesan resmi hindari bentuk singkat dan pakai may dan could untuk permintaan.

description.ar: تعلّم أن تعتذر وتطلب وتشكر بأدب كما يفعل الناطقون بالإنجليزية.
description.en: Learn to apologise, request and thank politely like native speakers.
description.id: Belajar meminta maaf, meminta, dan berterima kasih dengan sopan seperti penutur asli.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أعتذر وألفت الانتباه بأدب.
objectives.en: I can apologise and get attention politely.
objectives.id: Saya bisa meminta maaf dan menarik perhatian dengan sopan.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أطلب من أحد أن يكرر أو يفعل شيئًا.
objectives.en: I can ask someone to repeat or do something.
objectives.id: Saya bisa meminta seseorang mengulang atau melakukan sesuatu.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أرد على الشكر بشكل طبيعي.
objectives.en: I can reply to thanks naturally.
objectives.id: Saya bisa membalas ucapan terima kasih dengan alami.

intro.ar: الإنجليزية تعتمد كثيرًا على كلمات الأدب مثل sorry وexcuse me وplease. ستتعلم متى تستخدم كل واحدة وكيف تطلب بأسلوب لطيف.
intro.en: English relies a lot on politeness words like sorry, excuse me and please. You will learn when to use each and how to make requests gently.
intro.id: Bahasa Inggris banyak memakai kata sopan seperti sorry, excuse me, dan please. Anda akan belajar kapan memakai masing-masing dan cara meminta dengan halus.

culture.ar: في بريطانيا وأمريكا يقول الناس "sorry" حتى عندما يصطدم أحد بهم. وتُستخدم "Excuse me" قبل المقاطعة أو المرور، و"Pardon?" أو "Could you repeat that?" عندما لا تفهم.
culture.en: In Britain and America people say "sorry" even when someone bumps into them. "Excuse me" is used before interrupting or passing, and "Pardon?" or "Could you repeat that?" when you did not understand.
culture.id: Di Inggris dan Amerika orang bilang "sorry" bahkan saat ditabrak orang lain. "Excuse me" dipakai sebelum menyela atau lewat, dan "Pardon?" atau "Could you repeat that?" saat tidak mengerti.

body.ar: بعد Could you وWould you mind نستخدم فعلًا: "Could you repeat that?" و"Would you mind closing the door?" (لاحظ -ing بعد mind). ونردّ على الشكر بـ "You're welcome" أو "No problem".
body.en: After Could you we use a base verb: "Could you repeat that?" and after "Would you mind" we use -ing: "Would you mind closing the door?". We answer thanks with "You're welcome" or "No problem".
body.id: Setelah Could you dipakai kata kerja dasar: "Could you repeat that?" dan setelah "Would you mind" dipakai -ing: "Would you mind closing the door?". Terima kasih dibalas dengan "You're welcome" atau "No problem".

why.id: Balasan terima kasih adalah You're welcome. Sorry untuk minta maaf dan please untuk meminta.

summary.ar: تعلّمت sorry وexcuse me وCould you وWould you mind والرد على الشكر. الأدب في الإنجليزية يعني كلمات صغيرة كثيرة.
summary.en: You learned sorry, excuse me, Could you, Would you mind and how to answer thanks. Politeness in English means many small words.
summary.id: Anda belajar sorry, excuse me, Could you, Would you mind, dan cara membalas terima kasih. Sopan santun bahasa Inggris berarti banyak kata kecil.

description.ar: تعلّم أفعالًا مركبة وتعابير يستخدمها الناطقون كل يوم.
description.en: Learn phrasal verbs and idioms that native speakers use every day.
description.id: Pelajari phrasal verb dan idiom yang dipakai penutur asli setiap hari.

objectives.ar: أستطيع فهم أفعال مركبة شائعة مثل give up وfind out.
objectives.en: I can understand common phrasal verbs like give up and find out.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memahami phrasal verb umum seperti give up dan find out.

objectives.ar: أستطيع استخدام look forward to وget along with بشكل صحيح.
objectives.en: I can use look forward to and get along with correctly.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memakai look forward to dan get along with dengan benar.

objectives.ar: أستطيع استخدام تعبير شائع مثل a piece of cake.
objectives.en: I can use a common idiom like a piece of cake.
objectives.id: Saya bisa memakai idiom umum seperti a piece of cake.

intro.ar: الفعل المركب هو فعل مع حرف جر أو ظرف، ويتغير معناه عن الفعل وحده. اخترنا هنا الأكثر استعمالًا فقط، لأنك ستسمعها في كل مكان.
intro.en: A phrasal verb is a verb plus a small word, and its meaning changes from the verb alone. We chose only the most common ones here, because you will hear them everywhere.
intro.id: Phrasal verb adalah kata kerja ditambah kata kecil, dan artinya berbeda dari kata kerja sendirian. Di sini hanya dipilih yang paling umum karena sering terdengar di mana-mana.

culture.ar: الناطقون يفضلون "find out" على "discover" و"give up" على "quit" في الكلام اليومي. أما التعابير مثل "a piece of cake" فلا تُفهم حرفيًا، بل تعني "سهل جدًا".
culture.en: Native speakers prefer "find out" to "discover" and "give up" to "abandon" in daily talk. Idioms like "a piece of cake" are not literal; it means "very easy".
culture.id: Penutur asli lebih suka "find out" daripada "discover" dan "give up" daripada "abandon" dalam percakapan. Idiom seperti "a piece of cake" tidak berarti harfiah; artinya "sangat mudah".

body.ar: لا تترجم الأفعال المركبة كلمة بكلمة؛ احفظها كوحدة. بعض الأفعال تتبعها كلمة to أو with ثابتة: look forward to + اسم أو -ing، get along with + شخص. التعبير الاصطلاحي يُحفظ كما هو.
body.en: Do not translate phrasal verbs word by word; learn them as a unit. Some need a fixed word: look forward to + noun or -ing, get along with + person. An idiom is learned exactly as it is.
body.id: Jangan menerjemahkan phrasal verb kata demi kata; hafalkan sebagai satu kesatuan. Beberapa memakai kata tetap: look forward to + kata benda atau -ing, get along with + orang. Idiom dihafal apa adanya.

summary.ar: تعلّمت give up وfind out وlook forward to وget along with وrun out of وa piece of cake. احفظ كل فعل مركب كوحدة واحدة.
summary.en: You learned give up, find out, look forward to, get along with, run out of and a piece of cake. Learn each phrasal verb as one unit.
summary.id: Anda belajar give up, find out, look forward to, get along with, run out of, dan a piece of cake. Hafalkan setiap phrasal verb sebagai satu kesatuan.

title.ar: محادثات عملية: فندق وطبيب ومقابلة عمل
title.en: Practical conversations: hotel, doctor, job interview
title.id: Percakapan praktis: hotel, dokter, wawancara kerja

description.ar: طبّق كل ما تعلّمته في ثلاثة مواقف حقيقية: الفندق والطبيب والمقابلة.
description.en: Use everything you learned in three real situations: hotel, doctor and interview.
description.id: Terapkan semua yang Anda pelajari dalam tiga situasi nyata: hotel, dokter, dan wawancara.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أسجّل دخولي في فندق وأسأل عن مواعيده.
objectives.en: I can check in at a hotel and ask about times.
objectives.id: Saya bisa check-in di hotel dan menanyakan jam-jamnya.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أصف أعراضي وأفهم تعليمات الدواء.
objectives.en: I can describe symptoms and understand medicine instructions.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menjelaskan gejala dan memahami petunjuk obat.

objectives.ar: أستطيع أن أجيب عن أسئلة بسيطة في مقابلة عمل.
objectives.en: I can answer simple questions in a job interview.
objectives.id: Saya bisa menjawab pertanyaan sederhana dalam wawancara kerja.

intro.ar: هذا درس ختامي يجمع الماضي والمستقبل والأفعال الناقصة والعبارات المهذبة. كل جملة هنا ستسمعها فعلًا في فندق أو عيادة أو مكتب.
intro.en: This is a capstone lesson that brings together the past, the future, modals and polite phrases. You will really hear every sentence here in a hotel, a clinic or an office.
intro.id: Ini pelajaran penutup yang menggabungkan bentuk lampau, masa depan, modal, dan ungkapan sopan. Setiap kalimat di sini benar-benar akan Anda dengar di hotel, klinik, atau kantor.

culture.ar: في الفندق تُسأل عن اسمك وبطاقة هويتك، وفي العيادة يسألك الطبيب منذ متى تشعر بالألم، وفي المقابلة يبدأ المحاور غالبًا بـ "Tell me about yourself". الإجابات القصيرة والواضحة هي الأفضل في كل المواقف.
culture.en: At a hotel you are asked for your name and ID, at a clinic the doctor asks how long you have felt ill, and in an interview the interviewer often starts with "Tell me about yourself". Short, clear answers work best in all three.
culture.id: Di hotel Anda ditanya nama dan identitas, di klinik dokter menanyakan sudah berapa lama Anda sakit, dan di wawancara pewawancara sering membuka dengan "Tell me about yourself". Jawaban singkat dan jelas paling baik di ketiganya.

title.en: Choosing the right phrase for the situation
title.id: Memilih ungkapan yang tepat untuk situasi

body.ar: استخدم I have a... للأعراض، وI'd like... للطلب المهذب، وI have experience in... في المقابلة. في الجمل عن الماضي استخدم الماضي البسيط: "I worked in a hotel for three years".
body.en: Use I have a... for symptoms, I'd like... for polite requests and I have experience in... in interviews. For past experience use the past simple: "I worked in a hotel for three years".
body.id: Gunakan I have a... untuk gejala, I'd like... untuk permintaan sopan, dan I have experience in... dalam wawancara. Untuk pengalaman lampau pakai past simple: "I worked in a hotel for three years".

cloze.sentence: Excuse me, what time is ___? I need to leave at noon.

tr.ar: المعذرة، متى موعد المغادرة؟ أحتاج إلى الرحيل عند الظهر.
tr.en: Excuse me, what time is check-out? I need to leave at noon.
tr.id: Permisi, jam berapa check-out? Saya harus pergi siang hari.

why.ar: الشخص يريد المغادرة، فيسأل عن check-out. check-in للوصول وreception مكان لا وقت.
why.en: The person wants to leave, so he asks about check-out. Check-in is for arrival and reception is a place, not a time.
why.id: Orang itu ingin pergi, jadi bertanya check-out. Check-in untuk kedatangan dan reception adalah tempat, bukan waktu.

cloze.sentence: Take this medicine ___ a day, after meals.

tr.ar: خذ هذا الدواء مرتين في اليوم بعد الوجبات.
tr.en: Take this medicine twice a day, after meals.
tr.id: Minum obat ini dua kali sehari setelah makan.

why.ar: "twice a day" تعني مرتين في اليوم. second وago لا تعبران عن عدد المرات.
why.en: "Twice a day" means two times daily. Second and ago do not express how often.
why.id: "Twice a day" berarti dua kali sehari. Second dan ago tidak menyatakan frekuensi.

why.en: The interviewer asks for an introduction, so the right reply gives job and experience. The other two belong to different situations (clinic and hotel).
